devon: quick ping — my PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2422 is blocked by CI, failing two jobs on mac-pool. Can someone take a quick look? devon: failing build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/pr-2422/builds/1912 Error snippet: ``` FAIL tests/ui/settings_snapshot.test.js › settings pane renders correctly - Snapshot diff: whitespace change - Also: tests/kv/evict.test.js › should evict concurrently (timed out) ``` anya: I can check in ~20m. @mike any bandwidth to glance at the mac infra? :eyes: mike: looking now. job 1912 shows first attempt timed out on a jest worker, second attempt passed earlier in the build history. There are a few socket reset traces in the docker logs. lina: if second attempt passed, probably transient. We can trigger a targeted rebuild for the mac job only. Quick command we use: `curl -X POST https://api.buildkite.com/v2/organizations/redwood/pipelines/pr/builds/1912/jobs/##/rebuild` (token in vault). I'll queue it. sre-bot: Rebuild requested for build 1912 by lina — queued (est wait ~2m). devon: thanks. If the rebuild passes, do we still update the UI snapshot? The diff shows an extra trailing space inside a div: "0" vs "0 " — seems like noise. anya: paste the snapshot diff here? small whitespace diffs are often flaky across platforms. devon: pasted diff: ``` -
0
+
0
``` mike: yep that's whitespace-only. If rebuild passes and master hasn't moved, prefer to update snapshot in the same PR rather than force-merge. I'll hold approval until rebuild result. sre-bot: Build 1912 (rebuild) finished — status: passed. devon: perfect — I'll refresh the snapshot and push an update shortly. pinging for quick approvals when ready @anya @mike. anya: will review the snapshot change in ~10m. mike: approved once you push the snapshot update. merging in ~10m to give people time to object. :thumbsup: lina: FYI I added a flaky-marker comment to the kv evict test to avoid blocking other PRs; please follow up with a proper fix in a follow-up PR. (reacted :white_check_mark:) devon: noted. I'll open a follow-up issue to track a deterministic fix for the kv evict race. thanks everyone. anya: approved and left a small nit about test cleanup — not blocking. mike: merging now. devon: merged — thanks all.
